I have been farming this rented plot for some years now, and I know the soil here in Kilimanjaro is good but still needs help to give a decent maize harvest. I will buy some subsidized fertilizer from the voucher program and also use manure from our animals, because with only a quarter hectare I need every bag of maize I can get. I will plant improved seed since the extension officer said it does better here, but I cannot afford pesticides for maize and there is no water for irrigation so I must wait for the rains. My children and I will do most of the work with hand hoes, though I may hire a few days of help when it is time to plant quickly after the rains start.
